## Two-Developer Coordination Checklist
- [ ] Feature developed in an isolated branch (`feature/...`)
- [ ] No hardcoded API keys, passwords, or production secrets committed
- [ ] Linting passes (`make lint-backend`, `make lint-frontend`)
- [ ] Unit tests pass (`make test-backend`, `make test-frontend`)
- [ ] Accessibility standards verified (Touch target >= 56dp, high contrast)
- [ ] Privacy safeguards honored (No unverified OCR storing, no password auto-filling)
